title: Es ist nicht wichtig
desc: A request, taking four minutes to arrive
setting: The eleventh evening on the same chair, and a Sunday she cannot get to.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Am Sonntag gehe ich immer auf den Friedhof. Jetzt geht das nicht.
steps.en: On Sunday I always go to the cemetery. That does not work now.

options.feedback: Kind, and it takes the asking away from her. Sometimes right. Not with her.

options.en: How long have you been doing that?
options.feedback: A real question, and it sends her somewhere else. She was going somewhere.
Say nothing and leave the room open. She needs the four minutes and she will use them.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Es ist nicht wichtig. Du hast sicher keine Zeit.
steps.en: It is not important. You certainly have no time.

options.feedback: Take the way out away, once, and wait. She will get there.
Honest, and it makes her start the whole approach again.
She built you an exit out of politeness and you walked through it.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Könntest du am Sonntag hingehen? Die Blumen musst du nicht kaufen.
steps.en: Could you go there on Sunday? You do not have to buy the flowers.

options.feedback: Two words. Anything longer makes her feel the size of what she asked.

options.en: Of course, gladly, no problem at all.
options.feedback: Warm, and three times too much. It tells her the favour was big.

options.es: Und was mache ich dort genau?
options.en: And what exactly do I do there?
options.feedback: Fair, and she has already told you: the can is at the fountain, third row.

steps.speaker: Rosmarie
steps.es: Und sag ihm Grüezi von mir.
steps.en: And say Grüezi to him from me.

options.feedback: She said it the way you send a greeting to a neighbour. Take it the same way.
Now it is a moment, and she was trying very hard for it not to be one.
She talks to him every morning. She told you that two years ago.
